name: harmonic_pattern_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Harmonic patterns (AB=CD, Gartley, Butterfly) are Fibonacci-based price structures where the completion point (D) predicts a reversal with 55-60% accuracy. In Indian intraday markets, the AB=CD pattern on 1-min charts identifies institutional VWAP-execution waves: A→B is the initial impulse (institutional entry), B→C is the retracement (profit-taking), C→D is the second leg (institutional continuation). When D completes at a key Fibonacci extension (1.0, 1.272, or 1.618 of AB), the move is likely exhausted and mean-reversion begins. The inefficiency exists because: (1) pattern detection on 1-min bars requires automated scanning across many stocks, (2) Fibonacci levels create self-fulfilling prophecy — enough traders watch them to create real support/resistance, (3) the pattern filters out noise by requiring specific geometric relationships, improving signal quality over random entry.
mechanism: Institutional order flow arrives in bursts via algorithmic execution (TWAP/VWAP slicing), creating persistent directional pressure over 30-120 seconds. Retail and smaller participants follow the initial move, extending momentum before liquidity absorbs the flow and the order book rebalances.

indicators.name: swing_detector
indicators.formula: zigzag(close, threshold=0.1%) identifying A, B, C, D pivot points

conditions: bearish ABCD pattern completing at D (AB down, CD down, D is the bottom)
D_price near a VWAP or support level (confluence)
bullish ABCD pattern completing at D (AB up, CD up, D is the top)
D_price near a resistance level or VWAP overhead

exit.signal_exit: price closes beyond D by > 1 ATR(14) (pattern failed)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 22 (patterns are less reliable in high volatility)
filters.volume_filter: volume at D-point bar > SMA(volume, 20) (confirms interest at completion)

weaknesses: Zigzag and pivot detection on 1-min bars is extremely noisy. The 0.1% threshold generates many false pivots, and pattern detection has high look-ahead bias if not carefully implemented.
Fibonacci levels have no fundamental basis — they work only to the extent that other traders believe in them. In Indian markets, harmonic pattern awareness is growing but still limited.
The pattern's tolerance ranges (0.836-1.322 for ratio, 0.382-0.886 for retracement) are wide enough that many random price movements will falsely qualify as patterns.
prior_art: Carney (1999) 'The Harmonic Trader' — original harmonic pattern framework. Pesavento & Jouflas (2008) 'Trade What You See'. In India, harmonic patterns are popular on tradingview.com among Indian retail traders, but systematic 1-min implementation is rare.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
